_comment: The library's source allowlist (owner Q304: the library is ODbL 1.0). A source whose provider is not under 'allowed' refuses an entry. Generated from the engine's Providers/Elevation/*.elv licence fields on 2026-11-02: EVERY row is to be confirmed by the owner before launch (design: 'Allow each only after its terms are checked').
